mapper.insert:

mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.document_id, d.title AS document_title, c.chunk_index, c.chunk_text, c.embedding, c.token_count, c.created_at FROM knowledge_chunk c LEFT JOIN knowledge_document d ON c.document_id = d.id ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id, c.document_id, d.title AS document_title, c.chunk_index, c.chunk_text, c.embedding, c.token_count, c.created_at FROM knowledge_chunk c LEFT JOIN knowledge_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE c.document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY c.chunk_index
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (document_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, embedding, token_count, created_at) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkText}, #{embedding,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tokenCount}, NOW())
